## History

Joe Sloane was one of the students in Anne's classroom on a day she experienced a series of frustrating mishaps. During that day, Joe accidentally set off a package of fireworks that he had brought to school.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), +21 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--joe-sloane.md)

Joe Sloane is a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) teaches. He is present in her classroom during her difficult days as an educator, including an incident where Anne's bad mood and a toothache culminate in fireworks accidentally exploding in the schoolroom.
